text:
Using a severed hand that holds a
candle, you assemble a magic item
called a Hand of Glory. If you light
the candle, you may use this to
automatically avoid any one
encounter (except encounters
with undead, zombies, unique
zombies, demons or a monster
from the Lab Horrors table - these
are all immune), as the Hand of
Glory gives you the power to
paralyze any one mortal staring at
the flickering candle. After one
use, the hand will wither and the
candle will be used up. You may
create another Hand of Glory if
you happen on this event again.
Each use of the candle forces you
to pass a L5 Will roll or lose 1 Sanity.

zh-CN.title: 33 - 荣耀之手
text: 你用一只握着蜡烛的断手制作出名为“荣耀之手”的魔法物品。点燃蜡烛后，你可以用它自动避开一次遭遇；亡灵、僵尸、独特僵尸、恶魔以及实验室恐怖生物表中的怪物除外——它们都不受影响。荣耀之手能让任何盯着烛火的凡人僵住。使用一次后，手会枯萎，蜡烛也会烧尽。若再次触发本事件，你可以再制作一只荣耀之手。每次使用蜡烛，你都必须通过L5意志检定，否则失去1点理智。
